## <a id="decisions"></a>Decision history

[Owner decision history](decisions/generated-decisions.md) (recorded with `omni tracks decide`) · [decision guide](decisions/README.md). A decision applies to one exact revision (recommendation id, rev and revision hash); a later revision never inherits it, and changed inputs flag renewed review. A proposal is never treated as approved, and an accepted one is not a transaction.
